note: One build over the shared `scb-coding-registers` source: each register carries one replaced claim, and each projection is scoped to its register (state rows by `register`, entry issues by the entry's subject `<register>.5`, output issues by `scb/<register>/value`) and names the claim in its `note`. Expected values come from the replaced assertions (statuses, issue codes, case ids, segment windows and members) and from the fixture lists; where the replaced test asserted a compiled case or a resolution segment, the projection is that segment's published state or value-set row. A pin-free entry (no `expected_evidence_sha256`) is recompiled from each build's lists, so the old tests' stored-case drift legs have no build form; the compile-time staleness each one would meet is a register here. Registers 65-70 are own-source certificates (exact rows with the `source_codings` and `raw_codings` placeholders). The SOS register syn carries member-level years inside one Kodlista: SCB widens item validity to the edition, so only SOS reaches a member narrower than its list.
fails_if: any one of, per register: `compile_coding_selection` stops matching a choice's kept label and competing `over` labels exactly (keepgone, overgone), stops comparing `keep_members` or `keep_members_sha256` with the kept list's members (keepmembers, digestdrift, split), stops refusing a kept label shared by two distinct complete lists (keeptwice) or stops deduplicating identical lists by content (dup, digestdup), stops requiring a complete list to cover the whole window (partial), stops refusing uncoded or omit over a complete list (uncodedcoded, omitcoded), or stops checking an extension's label, members, witness and uncovered target (extendgone, extendwitness, extendmembers, extendtwice, extendcovered); `compile_coding_register` stops resolving an entry on a base variable to its partition child (split), or stops staling a period without a column occurrence or a column that resolves to no key (cardinality); `apply_coding_choices` applies a choice beyond its own window (window), lets overlapping disagreeing choices or omit and uncoded each win their overlap instead of withholding it (conflict, omitclash), or reports agreeing overlapping choices as a conflict (agree); an uncoded, omit or extend entry stops publishing its decision (uncoded, omit, extend); a `[[coding.warning]]` changes the coding it annotates (warning); a range-less pooled list blocks a finite choice or is consumed by a finite uncoded acceptance instead of staying `unsupported_coding_scope` (undated, undateduncoded); a `[[coding.documented]]` own certificate stops applying with its exact rows and raw fingerprints (owncert), stops comparing its raw fingerprints, members, labels or periods with the source (owncertraw, owncertmember, owncertlabel, owncertperiod), or an exact-row authority without raw fingerprints counts as an own certificate over a complete list (docauthority); or an extension stops accepting a list member valid only inside its witness, accepts a witness whose members vary, or an uncoded acceptance stops covering a window with no active member (SOS register syn: SHORT, VARY, EMPTY) Also: extendlater stales when `compile_coding_selection` counts the incomplete 2021 claim labelled `list` as a competing witness list.
